subject: Tomorrow: Modeling geographic variation in tree allometry

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Tomorrow: Modeling geographic variation in tree allometry
parts:
Hi all,

Tomorrow Catherine Hulshof will present a case study for feedback at the D-RUG meeting.  From Catherine:

Using the Forest Inventory and Analysis National Program database, I investigated the geographic distribution and underlying determinants of tree height-diameter allometries. I quantified the effects of forest stand density and climate on height-diameter relationships for 300 tree species across the United States by using spatial simultaneous auto-regression models in combination with a null model-based test of assembly. I also extracted the residuals from species specific height-diameter relationships to understand the effects of climate and forest structure on within-species variability in growth strategies. I would like to brainstorm additional analyses that may be used to determine the influence of climate and forest structure on intraspecific variation in height-diameter allometries.

We'll have our regular Q&A and work session in the second half.  See you at the regular place and time: 2124 Wickson, 1-3PM.

Noam
